stem: A reusable propagation tray has visible roots and media stuck to it after washing. What should happen before disinfection?
choices: Disinfect it immediately because residue does not affect the process
Continue cleaning until gross organic material is removed, then disinfect according to procedure
Dry it in direct light and skip disinfection
Use it only for the same cultivar
rationale: Gross organic material should be removed before disinfection when the sanitation procedure calls for cleaning followed by disinfection.
